title: Europe’s youth asked for hope – but politicians just offer fear and hate
lede: As Europe pours billions into defence and talks up ‘strategic autonomy’, it is quietly undermining its own power by ignoring the students who say they can’t afford the education, housing or stability needed to keep the continent running.
